title: Celigo script
description: Fields for creating or updating a script.
x-celigo-ai-guidance: Fields that can be sent when creating or updating a script

x-celigo-canon.reason: Server requires a non-empty name and rejects values longer than the declared maxLength. Bounds mirror live server enforcement.

description.description: Free-text explanation of what the script does.
examples: Adds discount line items to each order before import

x-celigo-canon.reason: Freeform user text — low sample cardinality is a population artifact; no enum or pattern to encode.
Left unconstrained — source content is not persisted in the warehouse, so no population evidence exists and the server cap is unknown.

content.description:
JavaScript source code. Optional on create — the server initializes
omitted content to an empty string. Omitting it on update leaves the
stored source unchanged (it is not cleared).
x-celigo-ai-guidance: JavaScript source code content of the script.
Optional. Omitted on create = empty script; omitted on update = existing content preserved.

sandbox.description: When true, the script runs in an isolated sandbox environment. Deprecated — all scripts now run in sandboxed mode by default.

postResponseHookToProcessOnChildRecord.description: When true, postResponseMap hooks run once per child record in a one-to-many mapping instead of once per parent.
x-celigo-ai-guidance: Whether to process hooks on child records.

_templateId.description: Optional template identifier used to generate or structure script content.
